Diagrammtyp & Architektur-Kontext UML-Klassendiagramm zur Definition des AUTOSAR-ECU-Konfigurationsmetamodells (ECUC Parameter Configuration) für das BSW-Modul CAN Interface ( CanIf ) im Kontext des AUTOSAR-Classic-Stacks. Das Metamodell beschreibt die hierarchische Containerstruktur aus Moduldefinition ( CanIf :EcucModuleDef ), Top-Level-Konfigurationscontainern ( EcucParamConfContainerDef ) und verschachtelten Subcontainern. 2. Komponenten, Entitäten & Schnittstellen - Übersichtstabelle (Included Containers) : - CanIfInitCfg : Multiplicity 1 , This container contains the init parameters of the CAN Interface. - CanIfPrivateCfg : Multiplicity 1 , This container contains the private configuration (parameters) of the CAN Interface. - CanIfPublicCfg : Multiplicity 1 , This container contains the public configuration (parameters) of the CAN Interface. - CanIfTrcvDrvCfg : Multiplicity 0.. , This container contains the configuration (parameters) of all addressed CAN transceivers by each underlying CAN Transceiver Driver module. For each CAN transceiver Driver a seperate instance of this container shall be provided. - Modulwurzel : - CanIf: EcucModuleDef ( lowerMultiplicity = 0 , upperMultiplicity = 1 ). - Top-Level-Container (Aggregation via +container ): - CanIfPublicCfg: EcucParamConfContainerDef ( lowerMultiplicity = 1 , upperMultiplicity = 1 ). - CanIfPrivateCfg: EcucParamConfContainerDef . - CanIfDispatchCfg: EcucParamConfContainerDef . - CanIfTrcvDrvCfg: EcucParamConfConta
